title: SO3-Cell: Standard Cell Layout Automation Framework for Simultaneous Optimization of Topology, Placement, and Routing
problem: Standard cell layout design lacks automated simultaneous optimization of circuit topology, transistor placement, and internal routing; traditional sequential approaches are suboptimal.
motivation: Custom cell layouts with optimized area, power, and timing require integrated design space exploration.
method: Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) formulation for simultaneous topology, placement, and routing optimization; design space pruning techniques for scalability.
key_novelty: First automatic standard cell layout framework using MILP for simultaneous T+P+R optimization.
contributions: MILP formulation for simultaneous topology, placement, and routing
Design space pruning techniques for scalability
35% power reduction, 2.2% frequency improvement, 31.1% area reduction

metrics.ppa: 35% power reduction, 2.2% frequency improvement, 31.1% area reduction

limitations: MILP scalability limited; runtime grows exponentially with circuit size; evaluation limited to small cells (full adder, flip-flop).
